metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is asking about artificial land built off the coast of Jakarta Bay as of 2021, specifically if it's greater than 800 hectares. This requires: 1. Identifying artificial/urban/built-up land in the Jakarta Bay area 2. Calculating the area in hectares 3. Comparing to 800 hectares For artificial land detection, I can use: - Landsat or Sentinel-2 imagery - NDVI (vegetation index) to distinguish built-up from natural areas - NDBI (built-up index) or other urban indices - Coastline detection to focus on offshore areas Approach: 1. Define Jakarta Bay area geometry 2. Get 2021 imagery (Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2) 3. Calculate built-up indices (NDBI, NDVI) 4. Classify artificial land 5. Calculate area in hectares 6. Compare to 800 hectares I'll use Landsat 8 for 2021 with cloud masking. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const jakartaBay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [106.6, -5.9], [107.1, -5.9], [107.1, -6.2], [106.6, -6.2], [106.6, -5.9] ]); const startDate = '2021-01-01'; const endDate = '2021-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 for 2021 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Landsat Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 8 images found, trying Sentinel-2..."); collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); const sentinelSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Sentinel-2 Images: ${sentinelSize}`); if (sentinelSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Create median composite and calculate indices const composite = collection.median(); // Calculate NDVI and NDBI for built-up area detection const ndvi = composite.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); const ndbi = composite.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); // Classify artificial land: high NDBI and low NDVI const artificialLand = ndbi.gt(0).and(ndvi.lt(0.2)); // 4. Calculate area const areaStats = artificialLand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: jakartaBay, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = areaStats.get('NDBI').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert pixel count to hectares (30m Landsat pixels) const pixelArea = 30 * 30; // square meters per pixel const areaHectares = (pixelCount * pixelArea) / 10000; console.log(`Artificial land pixels: ${Math.round(pixelCount)}`); console.log(`Area (hectares): ${Math.round(areaHectares)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (areaHectares > 800) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
